NOTE: Do NOT manually edit this file. This file is automatically updated when semantic release (release.yml) runs. Manually editing this file can break your releases and break third party tools that use this file.

patches.name: AMOLED dark theme force
patches.description: Forces AMOLED theme preference keys to their enabled state and can recolor dark theme values to pure black.

options.title: Force AMOLED Preference
options.description: Force known AMOLED/pure-black theme preference keys to report enabled.

options.title: Extra Preference Keys
options.description: Comma-separated additional preference keys to force enabled.

options.title: Recolor To Pure Black
options.description: Replace matching color values in res/values XML files with pure black.

options.title: Source Color
options.description: Color value to replace, as RRGGBB or AARRGGBB with a leading hash.

options.title: Target Color
options.description: Replacement color value, as RRGGBB or AARRGGBB with a leading hash.

patches.name: Ads-free rewards
patches.description: Experimental: reports rewarded ads as loaded and suppresses ad load failure callbacks so reward flows proceed. Granting rewards with no ad shown needs an extension and is not covered.

options.title: Force Ad Ready
options.description: Force rewarded ad readiness checks to report loaded.

options.title: Suppress Load Failures
options.description: Nop rewarded ad load failure callbacks.

patches.name: Allow screenshots and screen recording
patches.description: Removes preview hiding, capture restrictions, FLAG_SECURE flags, and detection callbacks.

options.title: Enable Recent App Previews
options.description: Allow viewing the app thumbnail in the app switcher.

options.title: Remove Capture Restrictions
options.description: Remove screenshot and screen recording blocking flags from activities.

options.title: Remove FLAG_SECURE
options.description: Remove FLAG_SECURE so applications cannot block screen captures (differs from remove capture restrictions).

options.title: Bypass Screenshot Detection
options.description: The app is not notified when a screenshot is taken.

patches.name: Bypass PairIP protection
patches.description: Defeats Google Play's PairIP guard: restores the original application class so the protection gate never starts, deletes libpairipcore.so, and strips PairIP components.

options.title: Restore Application Class
options.description: Point android:application back at the class PairIP wrapped, based on the stub's superclass.

options.title: Delete Native Core
options.description: Remove libpairipcore.so from every ABI so the guard cannot run even if something loads it.

options.title: Strip PairIP Components
options.description: Remove com.pairip activities, services, receivers, providers, and instrumentations from the manifest.

patches.name: Bypass Play Integrity
patches.description: Experimental: forces client-side Play Integrity verdict checks to report success. Integrity tokens validated on a server cannot be forged offline, so server-gated features stay gated.

options.title: Force Verdict Reads
options.description: Force Play Integrity verdict getter results to report success.

options.title: Force Verdict Methods
options.description: Make Play Integrity verdict methods return true. Assumes such checks return true when the device passes.

patches.name: Bypass Play licensing
patches.description: Makes licensing checks report success: forces licensing policy responses to licensed and suppresses denial callbacks. Server-side license verification cannot be bypassed this way.

options.title: Force Licensed Response
options.description: Force licensing policy responses to report licensed.

options.title: Suppress Denial Callbacks
options.description: Nop licensing denial and error callbacks.

patches.name: Bypass anti-tamper checks
patches.description: Defeats common anti-tamper checks: reports the Play Store as installer, forces signature comparisons to report a match, and can make signature digest methods report an intact app.

options.title: Spoof Installer Package
options.description: Report com.android.vending as the installer in getInstallerPackageName and PackageInfo reads.

options.title: Force Signature Checks
options.description: Force PackageManager.checkSignatures and checkUidSignatures to report SIGNATURE_MATCH.

options.title: Force Digest Checks Valid
options.description: Make boolean signature digest methods return true. Assumes such checks return true when the app is intact.

patches.name: Bypass root and debugger checks
patches.description: Reports the debugger as disconnected, hides root indicator files from existence checks. Works only on common detection methods.

options.title: Bypass Debugger Checks
options.description: Force Debug.isDebuggerConnected, VMDebug.isDebuggerConnected, and waitingForDebugger to report false.

options.title: Bypass Root File Checks
options.description: Make File.exists and related probes report false inside methods that reference su, magisk, or busybox paths.

patches.name: Change package name
patches.description: Renames the app package: rewrites the manifest package, components, and authorities plus matching dex strings, and can report the original package to the app. Permissions are stripped, never renamed. Binary assets referencing the package are left untouched.

options.title: New Package Name
options.description: Replacement package name written into the manifest and dex strings.

options.title: Rewrite Manifest
options.description: Rename the manifest package, component class names, and authorities.

options.title: Strip Permissions
options.description: Remove uses-permission entries instead of renaming them.

patches.name: Change package name (dex)
patches.description: Rewrites matching package string constants in dex code and can report the original package to the app.

options.title: Original Package Name
options.description: Package name to replace, as read from the manifest before renaming.

options.title: New Package Name
options.description: Replacement package name written into dex strings.

options.title: Rewrite Dex Strings
options.description: Rewrite matching package string constants in dex code.

options.title: Hook getPackageName
options.description: Force Context.getPackageName to report the original package.

patches.name: Cross-signal location consistency
patches.description: Returns no Wi-Fi scan or cell tower data so location cross-checks against Wi-Fi fingerprints and cell IDs cannot contradict the spoofed position.

options.title: Suppress Wi-Fi Scans
options.description: Force WifiManager.getScanResults to return null.

options.title: Suppress Cell Info
options.description: Force TelephonyManager.getAllCellInfo and getCellLocation to return null.

patches.name: Custom app name
patches.description: Replaces the application label shown in the launcher with a custom name.

options.title: App Name
options.description: Label shown in the launcher. Leave empty to keep the app's own label.

options.title: Override Activity Labels
options.description: Also replace android:label on activities and activity aliases that declare their own.

patches.name: DexGuard string decrypt hook
patches.description: Experimental, apply last: detects likely string decryptor methods and forces their results to empty so obfuscated string flows stay non-null. Server-driven or native decryptors are not covered.

options.title: Log Only
options.description: Log decryptor candidates without rewriting their results.

options.title: Force Empty Strings
options.description: Force decryptor call results to empty strings. Assumes callers tolerate empty values.

patches.name: Disable Play Protect hooks
patches.description: Strips APK-side verify hooks: removes package verification intent filters and verifier roles. Play Protect verdicts computed inside Google Play services cannot be changed from the app.

options.title: Strip Verification Filters
options.description: Remove PACKAGE_NEEDS_VERIFICATION intent filters from receivers.

options.title: Strip Verifier Roles
options.description: Remove package verifier roles from the manifest.

patches.name: Disable analytics collection
patches.description: Disables Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics, and Performance Monitoring data collection.

options.title: Disable Firebase Analytics
options.description: Force firebase_analytics_collection_enabled to false.

options.title: Disable Crashlytics
options.description: Force firebase_crashlytics_collection_enabled to false.

options.title: Disable Performance Monitoring
options.description: Force firebase_performance_collection_enabled to false.

patches.name: Disable boot start-up
patches.description: Removes boot intent filters so the app cannot start itself when the device boots.

options.title: Remove Boot Intent Filters
options.description: Strip BOOT_COMPLETED, LOCKED_BOOT_COMPLETED, and quickboot intent filters from receivers and services.

patches.name: Enable app backups
patches.description: Allows the app to back up its data.

options.title: Enable Backups
options.description: Sets android:allowBackup to true on the application tag.

options.title: Remove Backup Rules
options.description: Removes android:fullBackupContent and android:dataExtractionRules.

patches.name: Enable debugging and inspection
patches.description: Enables debugging flags, trusts user CA certificates, permits cleartext traffic for proxy inspection, and strips test-only restrictions in the application manifest.

options.title: Enable Debugging
options.description: Sets android:debuggable to true on the application tag.

options.title: Trust User Certificates
options.description: Accept TLS certificates signed by user-installed certificate authorities.

options.title: Allow Cleartext Traffic
options.description: Sets android:usesCleartextTraffic to true and permits cleartext traffic in the network security config.

options.title: Remove Test-Only Flag
options.description: Removes android:testOnly if present.

patches.name: Free in-app purchases
patches.description: Grants device-local purchases: forces purchase state to purchased, acknowledgements to true, and owned-item preference reads to true. Network-verified purchases stay gated.

options.title: Force Purchased State
options.description: Force Purchase.getPurchaseState to report purchased.

options.title: Force Acknowledged
options.description: Force Purchase.isAcknowledged to report true.

options.title: Force Owned Keys
options.description: Force SharedPreferences reads of owned-item keys to report true.

patches.name: GMS check strip
patches.description: Makes the app run without Google Play services: forces availability checks to succeed, suppresses error dialogs, and strips GMS package visibility. A lighter alternative to MicroG, which is heavier but more stable.

options.title: Force Availability Success
options.description: Report isGooglePlayServicesAvailable as success (0) and isUserResolvableError as false.

options.title: Suppress Error Dialogs
options.description: Nop Google Play services error dialogs and notifications.

options.title: Strip GMS Package Visibility
options.description: Remove GMS and Play Store entries from manifest package visibility queries.

patches.name: Hide app icon
patches.description: Removes MAIN/LAUNCHER intent filters so the app no longer appears in launcher app lists.

options.title: Remove Launcher Entry
options.description: Strip intent filters that combine android.intent.action.MAIN with the LAUNCHER category.

patches.name: Mask developer options and ADB state
patches.description: Hides developer state: reports adb_enabled and development settings as off and forces debug-revealing system properties to production values.

options.title: Mask ADB State
options.description: Force Settings reads of adb_enabled to report disabled.

options.title: Mask Developer Settings
options.description: Force Settings reads of development_settings_enabled to report disabled.

options.title: Mask Debug System Properties
options.description: Force ro.debuggable, ro.secure, and service.adb.root reads to report production values.

patches.name: MicroG support
patches.description: Adapts the app for MicroG: forces Play services availability checks to succeed, suppresses error dialogs, and drops the GMS client version check. MicroG is heavier than stripping GMS checks alone but more stable.

options.title: Force Availability Success
options.description: Report isGooglePlayServicesAvailable as success (0) so MicroG can serve the APIs.

options.title: Suppress Error Dialogs
options.description: Nop Google Play services error dialogs and notifications.

options.title: Remove GMS Version Meta
options.description: Remove the com.google.android.gms.version meta-data entry used for client version checks.

patches.name: Mock Play Billing client
patches.description: Mocks Play Billing client state: reports the client ready, feature checks as supported, and suppresses acknowledge, consume, and disconnect calls. Purchase query results cannot be fabricated without an extension.

options.title: Force Billing Ready
options.description: Force BillingClient.isReady to report true.

options.title: Force Feature Supported
options.description: Force BillingClient.isFeatureSupported to report OK.

options.title: Suppress Consume Calls
options.description: Nop acknowledgePurchase, consumeAsync, and endConnection calls.

patches.name: Open links in browser
patches.description: Stops http and https links from opening inside the app.

options.title: Remove App Link Verification
options.description: Remove android:autoVerify from intent filters.

options.title: Remove Link Intent Filters
options.description: Remove intent filters that handle http/https links.

patches.name: Spoof GPS
patches.description: Reports fixed coordinates: forces Location latitude, longitude, and related getter results to the configured position.

options.title: Latitude
options.description: Decimal degrees, positive north.

options.title: Longitude
options.description: Decimal degrees, positive east.

options.title: Spoof Accuracy
options.description: Force horizontal and vertical accuracy readings to a fixed value.

options.title: Accuracy (meters)
options.description: Reported location accuracy in meters.

options.title: Spoof Altitude
options.description: Force altitude readings to a fixed value.

options.title: Altitude (meters)
options.description: Reported altitude in meters.

options.title: Spoof Provider Name
options.description: Force Location.getProvider to report gps.

patches.name: Spoof device information
patches.description: Presents a different device entirely: rewrites Build identity field reads, forces matching system property reads, and overrides telephony operator and SIM identity getters using device and SIM presets.

options.title: Device Preset
options.description: Device build identity to present, including brand, model, and fingerprint.

options.title: SIM Preset
options.description: Carrier identity to present, including operator code, country, ICCID, and IMSI.

options.title: Spoof Build Identity
options.description: Rewrite android.os.Build field reads and matching ro.* system property reads to the preset.

options.title: Spoof SIM Identity
options.description: Force TelephonyManager operator, country, ICCID, and IMSI getters to the SIM preset.

options.title: Spoof Device IDs
options.description: Force getDeviceId, getImei, and getMeid to the preset IMEI.

patches.name: Spoof install location
patches.description: Reports internal storage as the install location, matching the Play Store default.

options.title: Set Manifest Install Location
options.description: Sets android:installLocation to internalOnly on the application tag.

options.title: Spoof Install Location Reads
options.description: Force ApplicationInfo and PackageInfo installLocation field reads to report internal storage (0).

patches.name: Spoof network transport type
patches.description: Reports a Wi-Fi connection: forces transport capability flags, hides the VPN transport, and overrides NetworkInfo type readings.

options.title: Force Wi-Fi Transport
options.description: Report the Wi-Fi transport in hasTransport checks and NetworkInfo type readings.

options.title: Force Cellular Transport
options.description: Additionally report the cellular transport in hasTransport checks.

options.title: Hide VPN Transport
options.description: Force hasTransport(TRANSPORT_VPN) to report false.

patches.name: Strip VPN checks
patches.description: Defeats VPN detection: reports VpnService.prepare as no consent required, the VPN transport flag as unset, and VPN string tests as false.

options.title: Bypass VpnService.prepare
options.description: Force VpnService.prepare to return null so no VPN consent prompt is issued.

options.title: Bypass VPN Transport Flag
options.description: Force NetworkCapabilities.hasTransport(TRANSPORT_VPN) to report false.

options.title: Bypass VPN String Checks
options.description: Force equals, equalsIgnoreCase, and contains tests against "vpn" string constants to report false.

patches.name: Strip mock location flags
patches.description: Reports Location.isMock and isFromMockProvider as false and forces mock location settings reads to report disabled.

options.title: Bypass Location Mock APIs
options.description: Force Location.isMock and Location.isFromMockProvider to report false.

options.title: Bypass Mock Location Settings
options.description: Force Settings reads of the mock_location key to report disabled.

patches.name: Strip sensitive permissions
patches.description: Removes sensitive Android permissions from the application.

options.title: Strip Camera
options.description: Remove camera access permissions.

options.title: Strip Microphone
options.description: Remove microphone and audio recording permissions.

options.title: Strip Location
options.description: Remove location tracking permissions.

options.title: Strip Sensors
options.description: Remove body sensor and activity recognition permissions.

options.title: Strip Contacts
options.description: Remove contacts access permissions.

options.title: Strip Phone & SMS
options.description: Remove phone, call log, and SMS permissions.

options.title: Strip Calendar
options.description: Remove calendar access permissions.

options.title: Strip Storage & Media
options.description: Remove media and storage permissions.

options.title: Strip Nearby Wi-Fi
options.description: Remove nearby Wi-Fi scanning permissions. May affect Wi-Fi status display.

options.title: Strip Overlay Access
options.description: Remove permissions that let the app draw over other apps or change system settings.

options.title: Strip Special Access
options.description: Remove package installer, usage access, and all-files access permissions.

options.title: Remove Queries Declarations
options.description: Remove all <queries> elements used to probe for other installed packages.

options.title: Remove QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES Permission
options.description: Remove the QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES permission that grants blanket visibility of installed apps.

patches.name: Strip trackers and telemetry
patches.description: Strips tracking, analytics, and advertising SDK components from the manifest, and their runtime calls.

options.title: Google & Firebase Analytics
options.description: Remove Google Analytics, Firebase Analytics, and AppMeasurement components.

options.title: Facebook SDK
options.description: Remove Facebook App Events and analytics provider components.

options.title: Attribution SDKs
options.description: Remove third-party attribution and tracking SDKs (AppsFlyer, Adjust, Branch, Kochava, Mixpanel, Flurry).

options.title: Crash Reporting SDKs
options.description: Remove Crashlytics and Microsoft App Center telemetry services.

options.title: Advertising ID & AdServices
options.description: Remove AD_ID and AdServices permissions to prevent advertising tracking.

options.title: Tracker SDK Calls
options.description: Replace void-returning calls into the stripped tracking SDKs with no-ops so they never run.

patches.name: Universal cleanup
patches.description: Debloats the app: removes debug and tracking components, extra locales, and stale install files. ABI splits, density filtering, and asset size filtering are not covered.

options.title: Strip Debug Components
options.description: Remove debug, staging, and test components plus LeakCanary, Stetho, and Chucker.

options.title: Strip GMS Components
options.description: Remove Google and Firebase service, receiver, and provider components.

options.title: Strip Extra Locales
options.description: Delete locale resource directories not on the keep list.

options.title: Keep Locales
options.description: Comma-separated locale qualifiers to keep; other locale resource directories are deleted.

patches.name: Unlock premium
patches.description: Enables premium features locally: forces premium status getters to report true and premium preference reads to report enabled. Server-side entitlements stay gated.

options.title: Force Premium Getters
options.description: Make boolean premium status getters return true.

options.title: Force Premium Preferences
options.description: Force SharedPreferences reads of premium keys to report true.

options.title: Extra Premium Keys
options.description: Comma-separated preference key substrings treated as premium keys.

patches.name: Unlock screen orientation
patches.description: Forces orientation unlock on apps that force an orientation.

options.title: Remove Orientation Locks
options.description: Removes android:screenOrientation attributes from activities.
